reason: Both answers correctly state the §412 three-month grace window, that the infringement is treated as commenced before registration, that registering now only protects against new infringers, that registration is required before suing, and that DMCA takedowns are the practical remedy. B adds the Copyright Claims Board, which allows statutory damages (up to $7,500 per work) for late-registered works with only a pending application. This is accurate and could change what the asker does, though B notes it is rarely viable against offshore pirate sites. B also gives the registration fees. A's extras (statute of limitations, expedited fee) are correct but matter less. B's headline is more complete and its content is accurate, so B is slightly better.
